rules.name: Swingfire
rules.description: A Team firing Swingfire missiles can remain Gone To Ground while shooting.

sharedRules.name: Milan Mount [Belgium]
sharedRules.description: Milan missile teams may fire while Mounted as a Passenger in a transport with a Milan Mount, using the Optional Milan Missile weapons line. [For Belgians, there does not seem to be a different statline.]

sharedRules.name: Sneak and Peek
sharedRules.description: A tank with Sneak and Peek can move 10" / 25cm at Tactical if it is not firing its main gun that turn.
